## Checklist

- [ ] Conventional commit title (`feat:` / `fix:` / `docs:` / `chore:`; `!` for breaking)
- [ ] Tests added or updated (TDD — failing test first)
- [ ] **README.md updated if this changes features or functionality** (minor fixes: no README change — CHANGELOG is automated)
- [ ] Affected `docs/` pages updated
- [ ] No entity ID renames (public API — needs dual-publish + deprecation if unavoidable)
